scoring_model.rule: category_points = category_weight * attained_level; no interpolation outside frozen levels

knockout_criteria.name: no_realistic_programmatic_action_submission
knockout_criteria.criterion: No realistic path exists to submit gameplay choices/actions programmatically without GUI automation or replacement of core rules/controller semantics.

knockout_criteria.name: insufficient_commander_multiplayer_partner_support
knockout_criteria.criterion: The frozen provider cannot execute the required four-player Commander session with the Ishai/Rograkh partner configuration sufficiently to exercise the contract.

knockout_criteria.name: not_reproducibly_buildable_or_startable
knockout_criteria.criterion: Under the provider's documented/supported prerequisites, repeated real attempts cannot build and start a bounded process. Transient dependency/network/runner failure is infrastructure_blocked, not a knockout.

knockout_criteria.name: unmaintainable_fork_depth
knockout_criteria.criterion: Required control/observation would demand a permanently invasive fork through core rules, networking, or UI layers rather than an isolatable and maintainable adapter/extension.

knockout_criteria.name: license_or_distribution_incompatibility
knockout_criteria.criterion: The provider license/distribution terms are demonstrably incompatible with the intended production architecture and cannot be isolated at a process boundary. Mere legal uncertainty is LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED, not a knockout.

knockout_criteria.name: no_usable_state_controller_hook
knockout_criteria.criterion: No usable provider hook can expose sufficient game state/legal-choice context and accept programmatic actions while preserving provider rules semantics.

notes: Static research prevents unjustified early knockout but does not award real-spike capability points.
No provider is selected in P3A.
P3B and P3C must use these exact frozen pins, contract hash, scoring hash and fixture hash unless an explicit pre-spike contract amendment is documented.
